evidenceBoundary: P1/P2 development evidence only; P3 remains sealed.
interpretation: The failure is not caused by missing/incomplete training evidence, resume corruption, or a single asymmetric performer split.
Both directions are similarly weak in absolute exact-string/fret quality, while cross-performer gaps remain within the frozen consistency limits.
The selected checkpoint occurs before epoch 1000 in both folds, so simply extending the same training schedule is not supported by this evidence.
Recall exceeds precision in both folds, consistent with substantial false-positive event prediction under the current objective/decoder.
Single-note and chord exact-string/fret performance are especially weak; scale performance is relatively strongest but still below threshold.
PalmMute supervision is extremely sparse relative to chords, especially for P2, so class/target imbalance should be explicitly examined in the next design.
nextDesignQuestions: Test loss reweighting or sampling strategies that address silence/active and content imbalance without changing the frozen evaluation population.
Inspect confusion by string/fret and event type to determine whether errors arise primarily from onset detection, fret classification, string assignment, or temporal run decoding.
Compare checkpoint curves and calibration/false-positive behavior to evaluate whether confidence-aware abstention or decoding can improve precision without collapsing recall.
Evaluate architectural/context changes on synthetic or already-authorized P1/P2-derived development diagnostics only; do not touch P3.
Any new real-data optimizer run requires a separately frozen V3 design and new explicit authorization.
